clauses.treatment_must_reach: >= 0.08 (pooled non-chaotic minus chaotic mean recall over 500 draws)
>= 0.06 (negated OLS chaos coefficient adjusted for strength)

eligibility.note: measured on control seeds 0..4 of the same family; treatment uses seeds 100..104

cheat_definition: CHEAT rows = positive-control rows with recall overwritten (chaotic -> 0, non-chaotic -> 1); detected = the unchanged evaluator reads every success clause as met on them, i.e. the instrument is not blind to success.

revisions.what: Run 1 with S1 threshold 0.15 and S3 threshold 0.15 (inherited from the magnitude used for this mechanism earlier): positive control reached only 0.103. Tried absorbing threshold THETA_PC in {0.02, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08}: gap 0.103, 0.082, 0.093, 0.079 (no setting reaches 0.15). Cause: by construction chaos costs about one species of four (77 of 98 chaotic draws end at recall 0.75), and non-chaotic neighbours already lose 0.24 species-fraction to exclusion, so the attainable gap in a world where chaos certainly causes loss is about 0.1. Changed S1 to >= 0.08 and S3 to >= 0.06; kept THETA_PC = 0.02. The label-permutation null has standard error about 0.022 at n = 98/402, so 0.08 is about 3.6 SE above the null.
revisions.why: A threshold the positive control cannot reach makes the world unattainable (the defect this preregistration repairs).

revisions.what: Added CLAUSES, MIN_PER_CLASS = 20 eligibility and per-arm clause evaluation to controls.py so the rerun in the probe reproduces the clause verdicts in the same code path; no parameter changed; values identical to run 1.
